content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The idea of a sovereign digital commerce stack is simple: it's a complete combination of free and paid tools that give designers a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means no more relying on third-party platforms that take a cut of your sales. No more worrying about payment restrictions or platform outages. With a sovereign stack, you're in control of your sales, your customers, and your data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of a sovereign stack is a web hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. This is where your online store is hosted, and where customers can browse and purchase your products. Next, you need a backend logic layer, which is typically handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This is where payment processing, order storage, and product delivery are all handled. Finally, you need a data storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer information and order details.
Who This Is Built For and Why

A sovereign digital commerce stack is built for designers and creators who want to sell digital products online, but are blocked by payment restrictions or platform fees. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or fonts, this architecture gives you the freedom to collect payments from anywhere in the world, without relying on third-party platforms. It's perfect for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, where payment restrictions are common.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell digital products online without relying on third-party platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include a web hosting platform, a backend logic layer, a data storage solution, and a payment gateway like NOWPayments. These components work together to provide a fully operational online store that's free from platform fees and payment restrictions. With this architecture, you can sell digital products online with confidence, knowing that your customers are safe and secure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question is: how do I get started with building a sovereign digital commerce stack? The answer is simple: start with the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH, which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. This kit gives you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. And with instant download, you can start building your stack today.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5% on every sale, compared to 10% on Gumroad.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in learning more about selling digital products online, be sure to check out the related searches on our website. And if you're ready to start building your sovereign digital commerce stack, be sure to visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can purchase the Complete Builder Kit for just $197. This kit is worth $348 separately, so you'll be saving money while getting everything you need to succeed.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: create a new GitHub Pages site, set up a Cloudflare Workers account, configure your NOWPayments payment gateway, deploy your online store using Cloudflare Pages, and set up a data storage solution using Supabase or Google Sheets. Once you've completed these steps, you'll have a fully operational online store that's free from platform fees and payment restrictions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I configure my NOWPayments payment gateway?

Configuring your NOWPayments payment gateway is easy. Simply log in to your NOWPayments account, go to the settings page, and enter your API keys. Then, configure your payment gateway to accept the cryptocurrencies you want to sell.
What is the difference between a sovereign digital commerce stack and a platform like Gumroad?

The key difference is that a sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full data ownership and control over your sales, whereas a platform like Gumroad takes a cut of your sales and has control over your data.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack to sell physical products?
No, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed specifically for selling digital products online.
How do I handle customer support with a sovereign digital commerce stack?
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you have full control over customer support. You can set up a support email address, a contact form, or even a live chat system to handle customer inquiries.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack to sell ebooks and courses?

Yes, a sovereign digital commerce stack is perfect for selling ebooks and courses online. You can use the payment gateway to collect payments, and the data storage solution to store customer information and order details.
By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can take control of your sales, your customers, and your data.
